tool_args.rationale: The zero-step observation returns x_now, while positive and negative input steps produce opposing deviations that generally decay with horizon. Fit normalized step-relaxation candidates numerically and select their complexity by leave-one-out prediction error; fresh confirmation will test the extrapolation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed response includes the present state and has departures from a single shared decay rate.
The opposing shifts depend on the input step, which a fixed mean alone does not explain.
Already acquired; the expanded observations support fitting and comparing low-dimensional relaxation models before further measurement.
It is not informative about the step-relaxation mechanism.
